title: fix(platform-objects): show a user's manager and direct reports in Setup, prefill Set Manager, add Remove Manager
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_
Fixes #36017

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:平台管理员在 Setup → 用户 → 打开某个用户时,详情页新增「汇报关系」一栏显示其经理、「直接下属」列表显示向其汇报的人;「设置经理」对话框打开时预先填好当前经理;新增「移除经理」按钮可清空经理(仅在该用户确有经理时出现)。
- 为什么做:外部开发者反馈,管理员设置经理后在界面上找不到读回的地方,也无法把误设的经理移除;这影响审批路由与团队可见范围的维护。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是管理员看到的经理/下属显示不准,或移除失败并看到服务端的拒绝提示;写入仍只经过原有的管理员接口,所有拒绝规则不变,改动可整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

An admin who set a user's manager could not read it back anywhere in Setup (the value was stored correctly; the card measured it over the data API). Four parts, each on an existing declared mechanism, no spec key added:

1. **Details → Reporting Line** section names `manager_id` (`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`). The field stays `readonly: true` (ADR-0092 D4); it is shown, not edited. Named "Reporting Line", not "Organization": the reporter mistook the Organizations tab (membership) for the org structure, and a section called "Organization" would repeat that. `primary_business_unit_id` (same field group) is deliberately left out: it is plugin-sharing's projection of `sys_business_unit_member.is_primary`, and the Business Units tab already lists the source rows with their primary flag.
2. **Details → Direct Reports**: a `record:related_list` of `sys_user` on `relationshipField: 'manager_id'` (parent value `id`, the props default). It is read-only by construction: `sys_user` opens no create or delete (`userActions: { edit: true }`, `apiMethods` without create/delete), so the host offers neither New nor Remove. Labels in the page's 11 locales.
3. **Set Manager opens on the current manager**: the `managerId` param is now field-backed on `manager_id` with `defaultFromRow: true` (the existing key; precedent `sys_team_member`'s `teamId`). Measured: the console's resolver (`ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`) seeds from `field ?? name` and carries type, target and label but never `readonly`, and `paramToField` builds the widget without it, so the picker stays editable. The record header stamps its record as the row; a list row is projected with every `defaultFromRow` seed field (`@object-ui/core` `listViewPredicates`). Request body unchanged: `{ userId, managerId }`.
4. **Remove Manager** (`remove_user_manager`, new action): posts the same endpoint with `bodyExtra: { managerId: null }` (the existing static-body key, merged last at both doors). Same `requiredPermissions` and the same standing term as Set Manager, then `has(record.manager_id) && record.manager_id != null`, so it is only offered while there is a manager to remove (the Ban / Unban row-state pattern). `confirmText`, no params, no `ai` block (an action after the ADR-0011 assessment stays human-only). ⛔ No client-side copy of any endpoint refusal (ruling record 6895645364 option A); the SCIM-held refusal applies to the clear at the endpoint.

Decision batch #127 item 1 is untouched: the manager is `sys_user.manager_id` alone; nothing reads or derives a business unit head.

## Tests

- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user-details-tab.test.ts`: the section list (Reporting Line added) and a new top-level describe: the Details section holding `manager_id`, the Direct Reports list on `sys_user` / `manager_id` / parent value `id` (read through `RecordRelatedListProps`), labels in the tab's locales.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts`: the param is field-backed + `defaultFromRow` (replacing the old INLINE pin, whose read-only rationale was measured false), and a new describe for `remove_user_manager`: `bodyExtra` equal to `{ managerId: null }` with the key present, no params, `confirmText`, gate keys equal to Set Manager's, the standing term first, the only record column read is `manager_id`, offered/hidden verdicts through the CEL engine, no `ai` block.
- `packages/runtime/src/platform-admin-action-gate.test.ts`: a new describe driving the real declaration through the REST action door: an admin's click is forwarded to `/api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` with `userId` and `managerId` present and null; a plain member is refused 403 and nothing is forwarded.

Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, src-resolved in both suites): deleting the `bodyExtra` line turned the runtime door test and the platform-objects declaration test red; restore proven (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).

## Acceptance notes

- The record page reads the manager through the console's own read path (list route, `filter` by id, `populate=manager_id`), measured on a booted showcase: the populated `manager_id` comes back as the manager's record with `name`. The painted Console page was not observed in a browser (Console build not run); the details renderer's lookup display is pre-existing behaviour.
- `sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts` previously pinned the param INLINE because a field-backed param "may render read-only". Measured on `ui/` at this tree: neither `resolveActionParams` nor `paramToField` carries `readonly` onto a param. The comment and the pin are rewritten with that reading.
- Open PR #36133 also edits `sys-user.page.ts`; `overlap-check` reports it merges cleanly with this branch.

## Verification

- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/pages/sys-user-details-tab.test.ts src/identity/sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts` → 2 files, 25 tests pass.
- Read first (by risk): `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` (the `remove_user_manager` block and the `set_user_manager` param), `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts` (the Details tab), `packages/runtime/src/platform-admin-action-gate.test.ts`.

<details><summary>Booted showcase, server-side measurement (own port, torn down)</summary>

- Set Manager through the action door with the field-backed param: `{"success":true,"data":{"userId":"usr_showcase_auditor_demo","managerId":"…","setBy":"…"}}`.
- `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user/usr_showcase_auditor_demo?expand=manager_id` and the console's list read (`filter` id, `populate=manager_id`): `manager_id` comes back as the manager's record, `name: "Dev Admin"`; without expansion it is the bare id.
- Direct Reports read (`filter manager_id = admin id`): 2 rows; control (`manager_id = Ada`): 0 rows.
- Served `sys_user` metadata keeps `bodyExtra: {"managerId": null}` and the param's `field` + `defaultFromRow`; served `sys_user_detail` carries Reporting Line, Direct Reports and `relationshipField: manager_id`.
- `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_user/remove_user_manager`: `{"success":true,"data":{"userId":"usr_showcase_auditor_demo","managerId":null,…}}`; afterwards `manager_id` reads `null` and the admin's reports drop to 1.
</details>
